summary: Moderator feature testing (P2). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passing against /api/mod/verify, /api/mod/reports (list/filter), /api/mod/reports/:id/resolve, /api/mod/reports/:id/reopen — including auth gating, wrong/no token 401, non-existent 404, full lifecycle (seed via socket → open → resolve → resolved → reopen → open) with stats + persistence assertions, plus backward-compat check (new stranger reports default resolved=false). Frontend: /mod sign-in gate, wrong token toast + stay on gate, correct token 'cs-mod-2026' unlocks reports console, stats cards render, filter tabs (open/resolved/all) work, resolve moves row to Resolved tab with stats update (open 3→2, resolved 1→2), reopen returns it to Open, session storage token cleared on sign-out. Chat regression (landing → nickname → sidebar → send message) still works.

ui_bugs.issue: Required 'moderator ↗' footer link with [data-testid='footer-mod-link'] is NOT rendered. The review request explicitly lists this element, but Landing.jsx (lines 197-204) only shows copyright + tagline text. No occurrence of the word 'moderator' anywhere on the landing page. Users have no discoverable way to reach /mod from the UI.

action_items: Add the missing 'moderator ↗' footer link on Landing.jsx with data-testid='footer-mod-link' navigating to /mod. Example placement: inside the existing footer div (lines 197-204). Suggested: <Link to='/mod' data-testid='footer-mod-link' className='font-mono-ui text-xs text-[#5c6069] hover:text-[#f2f3f5]'>moderator ↗</Link>
critical_code_review_comments: server.js `resolveReport` accepts arbitrary `note` from body without a max size check on the server side — db.js does slice(0,500) so it's fine at the DB layer, but consider a Zod/Joi validator for consistency.
server.js `requireMod` correctly rejects when MOD_TOKEN is empty (503) — good defensive behaviour.
modApi.js `verifyToken` passes token in body AND header (line 31 sends both). Fine, but redundant.

Moderator.jsx `tryAuth` in useEffect calls setAuthed(true) even for a stored (potentially stale) token before verifying — but current code does verify first via /api/mod/verify, so behaviour is correct.
db.js `listReports` runs a per-row `countReportsForDevice` query — N+1 pattern. Fine for small volumes but should be optimised (a single GROUP BY) if reports grow.
reports table has no index on `resolved` or `reported_device_id`; recommended for future scale.
Moderator.jsx: no confirmation dialog before resolve/reopen — acceptable for mod UX but worth flagging.
No pagination UI in Moderator.jsx despite backend supporting limit/offset — currently hardcoded limit=200 in modApi.js. If reports exceed 200, older ones become invisible.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 new mod tests + prior 18 chatroom tests all pass)
success_rate.frontend: 94% — 15/16 review items verified. 1 item (footer-mod-link) fails because element is missing.

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates fresh stranger reports via socket flow using TEST-* prefixed device IDs. Existing DB rows from iteration 1 (~3-4 rows) plus new ones from this run. Row #4 was resolved then reopened during UI testing — final state should be open.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds footer-mod-link on Landing.jsx, quickly re-run the frontend snippet in /app/test_reports/iteration_2.json action_items to confirm click navigates to /mod. Backend is fully verified — no need to retest unless code changes. To seed new reports for retesting: two socket clients with different deviceIds emit stranger:find → stranger:report (see TestModFullLifecycle.test_seed_resolve_reopen in test_moderator.py).
